messages:
Ivy: Heads-up: tonight's 00:30 UTC change window includes NATGW replacement + infra service account key rotation. Need coordinated rollback rules.
Ben: Risk: NATGW swap can briefly drop egress and make deploybot calls time out -> canary failure.
Rashid: Suggest split apply: 1) apply NATGW replacement with dry-run, 2) block traffic shift until IAM rotation validated.
Ivy: Plan: run terraform apply for NATGW in maintenance slot, set deploy-bot to treat timeouts as degradations (alert only) for 15m.
Ben: Add ssm param flag /infra/deploy/allow-timeouts=true during window so we can detect and revert easily.
Rashid: Deploy-bot exception: if error contains "timeout" or "EgressError" then hold rollback 15m and tag [natgw-iam-maint]. I can push rule.
deploy-bot: change created "natgw-iam-hold-1768881230" by Rashid. default_canary=10m rollback_on_any_failure=true
Ivy: Terraform snippet for NATGW resource (audit):
```
resource "aws_nat_gateway" "replacement" {
  allocation_id = aws_eip.nat.id
  subnet_id     = aws_subnet.egress.id
}
```
Ben: Owners: Rashid=deploy-bot exception, Ivy=NATGW apply + secret rotation, Ben=smoke canary auth check + SSM flag flip.
Rashid: TTL for exception 25m. Will tag @eng-oncall. Alerts still forward.
Ivy: Rollback rules: immediate rollback for functional errors (502/5xx), hold for timeout/auth errors up to 15m; if persists -> demote secret and abort release.
Ben: After NATGW is up, run quick curl to external endpoint from a canary host to validate egress before rotating keys.
Ivy: OK. I'll post readiness 45m before window and add release note: "NATGW replacement and deploy SA rotation; temporary timeout-hold on canary rollback." 
Rashid: Making the deploy-bot change now and tagging oncall.
deploy-bot: note: while exception active, alerts sent to #eng-oncall with tag [natgw-iam-maint].
Ben: LGTM, standing by for apply.
